written_charge.publicStructure: Written charge / requisition — offence statement, particulars, defendant identity block, court venue, return date.
written_charge.referenceNote: Informed by Criminal Procedure Rules forms catalogue (written charge / requisition structure).

indictment.publicStructure: Indictment — count header, STATEMENT OF OFFENCE, PARTICULARS OF OFFENCE, multi-count table where applicable.
indictment.referenceNote: Informed by Crown Court indictment practice and CPR indictment form structure.

mg05.publicStructure: MG5 case summary — defendant/complainant headers, offence summary, key evidence narrative, witness outline, limitations.
mg05.referenceNote: Informed by Home Office Manual of Guidance MG forms / national file standard (MG5).

mg06.publicStructure: MG6 file front sheet / index — multi-column inventory of papers with status (served / referred / absent).
mg06.referenceNote: Informed by MG6 national file front-sheet / index conventions.

mg06c.publicStructure: MG6C unused material schedule — schedule number, description, disclosure decision columns.
mg06c.referenceNote: Informed by MG6C unused schedule structure and CPS Disclosure Manual.

mg11_statement.publicStructure: MG11 witness statement — declaration, personal particulars boxes, numbered statement paragraphs, signature block.
mg11_statement.referenceNote: Informed by MG11 witness statement form structure (Manual of Guidance).

mg11_continuation.publicStructure: MG11 continuation sheet — carries statement URN/page continuation of an existing MG11 page 1; numbered paragraphs only.
mg11_continuation.referenceNote: Informed by MG11 continuation conventions; must not exist without a statement first page.

custody_record.publicStructure: Custody record extract — timed detention events, rights, reviews, authorising officer columns.
custody_record.referenceNote: Informed by PACE custody record structural fields commonly disclosed in case files.

interview_record.publicStructure: Interview / MG15-style record — tape/URN identifiers, caution, Q&A or summary blocks, exhibits produced.
interview_record.referenceNote: Informed by MG15 interview record structure in Manual of Guidance.

media_schedule.publicStructure: Media / BWV / CCTV clip schedule — clip id, source location, start/end, served-vs-master columns.
media_schedule.referenceNote: Informed by digital material disclosure practice (CPS Disclosure Manual Ch.30) and Common Platform media sections.

master_clip_schedule.publicStructure: Master-versus-clip continuity schedule — master ref, clip extracts, hash/path placeholders, absence markers.
master_clip_schedule.referenceNote: Informed by digital material / continuity disclosure expectations; masters may be referred-only.

phone_download_schedule.publicStructure: Phone / download / message schedule — device, extraction method, attribution columns, message/call rows.
phone_download_schedule.referenceNote: Informed by CPS digital material disclosure structure for device extractions.

disclosure_schedule.publicStructure: Disclosure schedule — item id, description, service state, sensitivity/PII flags.
disclosure_schedule.referenceNote: Informed by CPS Disclosure Manual schedule practice.

unused_schedule.publicStructure: Unused material schedule — schedule refs, brief description, relevance/disclosure decision.
unused_schedule.referenceNote: Informed by unused schedule / MG6C practice and Disclosure Manual.

forensic_report.publicStructure: Streamlined / forensic report — exhibit refs, methods limits, findings, SFR caveats.
forensic_report.referenceNote: Informed by Forensic Science Regulator code structure and SFR limits practice.

medical_report.publicStructure: Medical report extract — clinician header, examination findings, opinion limits, confidentiality banner.
medical_report.referenceNote: Informed by typical disclosed medical report sectioning used in criminal case files.

expert_report.publicStructure: Expert report — expertise declaration, instructions, opinion, limitations, CPR Part 19 style headers.
expert_report.referenceNote: Informed by CPR expert evidence form/structure expectations.

abe_record.publicStructure: ABE / visually recorded interview record — interview metadata, special measures note, transcript extract markers.
abe_record.referenceNote: Informed by Achieving Best Evidence / special measures structural fields in casefile practice.

hearing_notice.publicStructure: Hearing notice — court, listing date/time, hearing type, attendance requirements, case identifiers.
hearing_notice.referenceNote: Informed by HMCTS listing / hearing notice structural fields.

court_order.publicStructure: Court order — court header, parties, operative paragraphs, judge/clerk endorsement block.
court_order.referenceNote: Informed by CPR / HMCTS order form structure.

exhibit_schedule.publicStructure: Exhibit / MG12-style list — exhibit number, description, recovered by, location, continuity pointer.
exhibit_schedule.referenceNote: Informed by MG12 exhibit list structure in Manual of Guidance.

continuity_record.publicStructure: Continuity / chain-of-custody record — timed handovers, seal numbers, custodian signatures.
continuity_record.referenceNote: Informed by forensic continuity / exhibit movement practice.

defence_proof.publicStructure: Defence proof of evidence / privileged working extract — privilege band, instructions position, issues list.
defence_proof.referenceNote: Informed by defence case preparation structural practice; privilege-separated in fictional packs.

email_attachment_summary.publicStructure: Email / attachment summary — headers (From/To/Date/Subject), attachment inventory, hash placeholders.
email_attachment_summary.referenceNote: Informed by digital disclosure schedules for native email/attachments.

youth_justice_record.publicStructure: Youth justice / YOT record extract — age markers, appropriate adult, youth court listing fields.
youth_justice_record.referenceNote: Informed by youth justice casefile structural fields commonly disclosed.

interpreter_record.publicStructure: Interpreter / translation record — language, interpreter identity block, passages interpreted, certificate.
interpreter_record.referenceNote: Informed by interpreter/translation certification structures used in criminal proceedings.

welsh_language_record.publicStructure: Welsh-language proceedings record — language preference, bilingual headings, translation status.
welsh_language_record.referenceNote: Informed by Welsh Language Act / bilingual court document practice in England and Wales.

chronology.publicStructure: Case chronology — dated event rows linking procedure, disclosure and evidence milestones.
chronology.referenceNote: Informed by case-preparation chronology practice used across Common Platform / DCS packs.

metadata_fixture.publicStructure: Media metadata fixture — path/hash/codec/duration fields; native bytes marked not_exercised.
metadata_fixture.referenceNote: Informed by digital material metadata disclosure practice where natives are unavailable.

generic_specialist.publicStructure: Specialist / residual case document — titled sections appropriate to kind without universal sparse border layout.
generic_specialist.referenceNote: Fallback structural layout for specialist kinds; still kind-labelled and dense, not the V2.1.1 universal template.
